title: Student Clubs and Societies
content: UNZA typically has a range of student-run clubs and societies covering academic interests, culture, faith, debate, entrepreneurship, and more, often coordinated under the umbrella of the Students' Union or Dean of Students office. New students can usually find and join clubs during orientation week or through notice boards and social media groups run by the clubs themselves.
source: General information — verify with UNZA Students' Union

title: Sports at UNZA
content: UNZA generally offers sporting facilities and teams across various codes such as football, basketball, netball, athletics, and others, often organized through a sports department or student sports council. Students interested in joining a team or using sporting facilities should check with the sports office or relevant student sports body for current trials, schedules, and facility access.
source: General information — verify with UNZA Sports Department

title: Students' Union
content: The UNZA Students' Union typically represents student interests, organizes elections for student leadership positions, and coordinates various student welfare and social activities. It is often a good first point of contact for students wanting to get involved in campus life or raise concerns collectively.
source: General information — verify with UNZA Students' Union
